title: Getting Started with comex
text: comex package provides R interface ComexStat API Brazilian Ministry Development, Industry, Trade Services (MDIC). gives programmatic access : General trade data — exports imports 1997 present, 22 detail/grouping fields 6 metrics. City-level trade data — trade statistics broken municipality. Historical data — export/import records 1989 1996 using older NBM nomenclature. Auxiliary lookup tables — countries, economic blocs, states, cities, transport modes, customs units, product nomenclatures (NCM, NBM, HS, CGCE, SITC). package two dependencies (httr2 cli) require headless browser external software.

title: Querying Trade Data
text: Start discovery. Use comex_details(), comex_filters(), comex_metrics() building complex queries. Use filters reduce response size. API limit ~150,000 rows. query broad, API timeout. Add filters reduce date range. Filter codes integers. Use comex_countries(), comex_states(), comex_filter_values() find numeric codes. details parameter accepts user-friendly names. Write "hs4" (maps API heading), "transport_mode" (maps API via), "cgce_n1" (maps API BECLevel1), "sitc_section" (maps API SITCSection), "isic_section" (maps API ISICSection). package handles translation automatically. City endpoint fewer features. 7 details, 2 metrics (FOB KG), transport mode customs unit, product grouping stops HS4 (heading/chapter/section). Historical endpoint uses NBM. "ncm" detail available — use "nbm" instead.

title: Full state trade profile (Pernambuco example)
text: API serves one flow per request, make two calls combine results: resulting data frame one row per month × city × HS4 × country × flow combination:
code: exp_pe <- comex_query_city(   flow         = "export",   start_period = period_from,   end_period   = period_to,   details      = detalhes,   filters      = filtros,   month_detail = TRUE,   metric_fob   = TRUE,   metric_kg    = TRUE ) exp_pe$flow <- "export"  imp_pe <- comex_query_city(   flow         = "import",   start_period = period_from,   end_period   = period_to,   details      = detalhes,   filters      = filtros,   month_detail = TRUE,   metric_fob   = TRUE,   metric_kg    = TRUE ) imp_pe$flow <- "import"  pe <- rbind(exp_pe, imp_pe) str(pe) head(pe)

text: fairly common ComexStat API return rate limit errors (“Você excedeu o limite de solicitações. Por favor, tente novamente em 10 segundos.”) report timeouts. three package options can adjust work around errors: comexr.retry_time - number seconds wait failed request trying (default 10, increase get errors exceeding request limits) comexr.max_tries - maximum number times repeat failed request giving (default 3, adjusting comexr.retry_time generally better approach avoid errors without overloading ComexStat servers) comexr.timeout - maximum number seconds wait ComexStat servers respond (default 60 simple requests 120 complex requests; increase get errors timeouts) can set using options function: e.g. options("comexr.retry_time" = 30) set retry time 30 seconds.

text: flow Trade flow: "export" "import". start_period Start period "YYYY-MM" format (e.g. "2023-01"). end_period End period "YYYY-MM" format (e.g. "2023-12"). details Character vector detail/grouping fields. names user-friendly aliases; package translates underlying API name. API names returned comex_details("general") also accepted verbatim. Available options: Geographic: "country", "bloc" ("economic_block"), "state", "transport_mode" (API: via), "customs_unit" (API: urf) Products: "ncm", "hs6" / "sh6" (API: subHeading), "hs4" / "sh4" (API: heading), "hs2" / "sh2" (API: chapter), "section" CGCE (BEC): "cgce_n1", "cgce_n2", "cgce_n3" (API: BECLevel1, BECLevel2, BECLevel3) SITC/CUCI: "sitc_section", "sitc_division", "sitc_group", "sitc_subgroup", "sitc_basic_heading" (API: SITCSection, SITCDivision, SITCGroup, SITCSubGroup, SITCBasicHeading) ISIC: "isic_section", "isic_division", "isic_group", "isic_class" (API: ISICSection, ISICDivision, ISICGroup, ISICClass) filters Named list filters. Names match detail field names. Example: list(country = c(160, 249), state = c(26, 13)) month_detail Logical. TRUE, break results month. Default: TRUE. metric_fob Logical. Include FOB value (US$). Default: TRUE. metric_kg Logical. Include net weight (kg). Default: TRUE. metric_statistic Logical. Include statistical quantity. Default: FALSE. metric_freight Logical. Include freight value (US$, imports ). Default: FALSE. metric_insurance Logical. Include insurance value (US$, imports ). Default: FALSE. metric_cif Logical. Include CIF value (US$, imports ). Default: FALSE. language Response language: "pt", "en", "es". Default: "en". verbose Logical. Show progress messages. Default: TRUE.

title: comexr 0.4.0
text: Query results (comex_query(), comex_export(), comex_import(), comex_query_city(), comex_historical()) now typed: metric* columns numeric year / monthNumber integer. API returns every value string, previously columns character. Code called .numeric() metrics keeps working. SSL verification longer disabled automatically. SSL failures now raise error explaining opt options(comexr.ssl_verifypeer = FALSE). old option name comex.ssl_verifypeer still honoured.

title: comexr 0.4.0
text: comex_historical() failing HTTP 403: endpoint URL trailing slash (/historical-data/), API’s Cloudflare front now blocks. now calls /historical-data. comex_historical() returned whole years even period asked specific months (API ignores months). Results now trimmed requested months month_detail = TRUE, warning issued month_detail = FALSE period whole years. Fixed find function "%||%" R < 4.4.0 whenever API returned HTTP error (e.g. 429 rate limit). filters must now named list; unnamed entries used dropped silently, returning unfiltered data. Conversion errors API responses longer swallowed empty data frame. Column names API kept verbatim (make.names() mangling). validate_period() rejects invalid months (e.g. "2023-13") non-scalar input. Documented correct default month_detail (TRUE) comex_query(), comex_export() comex_import().
